description: Enqueue a background run for every agent of this tenant whose schedule is due (trigger_mode 'server_job', status active or provisioned, next_run_at in the past), and move each one's next_run_at forward by its interval. An agent with a working window (run_from/run_to/run_days, in its own timezone) that falls due OUTSIDE that window is not started: its next_run_at moves to the next opening and the run is skipped, not caught up. This is what the five-minute clock calls; a human can call it to make a schedule fire now instead of waiting. Returns which agents were started and which were deferred, with the reason. It does not wait for them to finish — watch /app/agent-runs for that. STARTS AGENTS that act on this tenant's data, so it goes through the permission gate.

dry_run.description: Only report which agents are due; enqueue nothing and change no schedule.

name: run_due_agents
